2608.25935.title: TAU-Agent: An Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Traffic Anomaly Understanding
2608.25935.paper_summary: Traffic Anomaly Understanding (TAU) requires models and systems to detect, reason about, and explain anomalous events in transportation videos. To address this challenge, we propose TAU-Agent, an agentic retrieval-augmented framework for traffic anomaly understanding. Given a task query, a central retrieval agent orchestrates two visual perception tools, namely a Video Captioning Tool and an Open-Vocabulary Tracking Tool, to retrieve and select query-relevant evidence, including captions, temporal intervals, and object trajectories. The selected evidence, together with sampled video frames and the input query, is provided to a supervised fine-tuned vision-language model for final reasoning and answer generation. We evaluate TAU-Agent on both the in-domain and the out-of-domain benchmarks from the AI City Challenge 2026. TAU-Agent achieves scores of 0.6779 on Track 3, 0.3998 on Track 7, and 67.9275 on Track 8, ranking second, twelfth, and fifth, respectively. Code is available at: https://github.com/siri-rouser/TAU-Agent.
2608.25935.paper_summary_zh: 交通異常理解（TAU）需要模型和系統來檢測、推理和解釋交通視頻中的異常事件。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了TAU-Agent，一個用於交通異常理解的代理檢索增強框架。給定一個任務查詢，一個中央檢索代理協調兩個視覺感知工具，即視頻標題工具和開放詞彙跟踪工具，以檢索和選擇與查詢相關的證據，包括標題、時間間隔和物體軌跡。所選證據連同採樣的視頻幀和輸入查詢一起提供給一個經過監督微調的視覺-語言模型，以進行最終推理和答案生成。我們在AI City Challenge 2026的領域內和領域外基準上評估了TAU-Agent。TAU-Agent在Track 3上獲得了0.6779的分數，在Track 7上獲得了0.3998的分數，在Track 8上獲得了67.9275的分數，分別排名第二、第十二和第五。代碼可在以下網址獲得：https://github.com/siri-rouser/TAU-Agent。
